content_zh:
西门焰焰绝美精致的小脸猛地煞白，咬紧玉齿，颤抖道：“爹爹，我是您唯一的女儿，是云霄城的公主，您让我像一个毛利蛮人跪下？”
中年男子目中一阵心疼，冷道：“没错，假如你还是我的女儿就跪下认错。做错了事情，就一定要受到惩罚！”
“不！”西门焰焰强忍着眼泪道：“爹爹，我可以给您跪下，可以给母亲跪下，却不可以再给其他任何人下跪。”
“我可以道歉，我可以认错，但是我绝不下跪。”西门焰焰猛地拔出一支精巧无双的火红匕首顶在自己雪白的玉颈上脆声道：“如果您一定要让我下跪，我就死在您的面前。”
“爹爹，我可以认错，可以道歉，但绝不下跪！”西门焰焰颤抖道，然后小手一压，锋利的匕首顿时刺破了她吹弹可破的肌肤，一缕鲜血顿时流下，在她雪白的粉颈显得尤为刺眼。
中年男子身躯一阵颤抖，猛地握紧拳头，怒不可赦地盯着自己的女儿，望着艳红的鲜血，脸上的肌肉猛地一阵抽搐，这是他最最疼爱的女儿，他的心肝宝贝。
西门焰焰对着阳顶天弯腰鞠躬道：“对不起，我错了，我不应该强买你的东西，更不应该打伤你，请你原谅！”
中年男子望着自己心爱的女儿，再望着阳顶天。
“唉……”中年男子叹息一声，转向阳顶天弯腰鞠躬到底。
“对不起了小兄弟，我西门无涯管教不严，而且心也不够硬，不忍见女儿血溅当场，无法强逼女儿跪下，我在这里给你道歉，请你原谅我女儿的过错！”
西门焰焰顿时惊呆了！自己的父亲可是整个云霄城至高无上的主人，何等的尊贵无双，何等的高傲显赫，此时竟然因为她向这个毛利野人鞠躬认错了。
西门焰焰觉得自己的心都要裂了，父亲是她最最崇拜最最敬仰的人。因为自己的过错，竟然让父亲受到如此耻辱。
“爹爹不要……”西门焰焰上前跪在自己父亲面前，扔掉手中的匕首，抱住父亲的双腿大哭道：“爹爹，我错了！我不应该仗势欺人，我不应该去伤他的性命，我更不应该用匕首伤害自己，用自己的性命来威胁您。”
“爹爹，其实我什么都知道。什么应该做，什么不应该做，但是，但是我真的管不住我的性子。”西门焰焰边哭边道。
西门无涯轻轻叹息一声，伸手抚摸女儿柔软的头发，道：“焰焰，你又多久没有哭过了？”
西门焰焰泣声道：“从十五岁那件事以后，我就再也没有哭过。”
这个云霄城的小公主刁蛮骄傲，倔强强硬，从来不低头从来不哭泣，今日却因为父亲的折腰而大声哭泣，尽管她知道是因为自己犯错，不应该去怪阳顶天，但是她内心却怎么也无法压抑对阳顶天的痛恨。
“东西呢？”西门无涯伸手道。
西门焰焰从怀中拿出那个火焰挂饰，望向这个挂饰的目光既恋恋不舍又充满痛恨，温顺地放在父亲的手中。
“你起来吧！”西门无涯道：“要性子，三思而后行！”

“是！我知道了。”西门焰焰低头道。
“还有，不许记恨这位小兄弟。”西门无涯继续道。
西门焰焰咬牙道：“爹爹，我无法做到内心不厌恨他。但是我以后不会报复他，不会针对他，更不会去害他。我会不理会他，不触碰他，连看他一眼都不愿意！”
说到后面，西门焰焰已经无法压抑自己的怨恨了。
西门无涯皱了皱眉头，挥挥手意兴阑珊道：“你出去吧……”
西门焰焰冷冷地瞪了一眼阳顶天后，转过娇躯走了出去。
*******
“小兄弟，你的挂饰。”西门无涯将火焰挂饰递给了阳顶天。
阳顶天拿过来重新挂在自己的脖子上，道：“西门先生很不好意思，如果是其他东西，我不介意送给西门小姐，但是这个火焰挂饰是我亲长给我的，对我非常重要。”
“我知道，而且就算不重要的东西，别人也不能强夺。”西门无涯道。
“对了，小兄弟要去哪里？如果要和我去的方向不一致，我可以拨一艘快船送你去要去的地方。”西门无涯道。
此时，阳顶天方才觉得这个房间微微有一些摇晃，道：“我们这是在大海上吗？”

content_en:
Ximen Yanyan's beautiful and delicate little face suddenly turned pale, she clenched her jade teeth and said tremblingly: "Dad, I am your only daughter and the princess of Yunxiao City. You want me to kneel down like a Maori barbarian?"
The middle-aged man felt distressed in his eyes and said coldly: "Yes, if you are still my daughter, then kneel down and admit your mistakes. If you do something wrong, you must be punished!"
"No!" Ximen Yanyan said while holding back tears: "Dad, I can kneel down for you, I can kneel down for my mother, but I can't kneel down for anyone else."
"I can apologize, I can admit my mistake, but I will never kneel down." Ximen Yanyan suddenly pulled out an exquisite and unparalleled fiery red dagger and put it on his snow-white jade neck. He said crisply: "If you must make me kneel down, I will die in front of you."
"Dad, I can admit my mistakes and apologize, but I will never kneel down!" Ximen Yanyan said tremblingly, then pressed her small hand, and the sharp dagger immediately pierced her skin that could be broken by a blow, and a wisp of blood immediately flowed down, which was particularly dazzling on her snow-white pink neck.
The middle-aged man's body trembled, and he clenched his fists fiercely. He stared at his daughter angrily, looking at the bright red blood, and the muscles on his face suddenly twitched. This was his most beloved daughter, his sweetheart.
Ximen Yanyan bowed to Yang Dingtian and said, "I'm sorry, I was wrong. I shouldn't forcefully buy your things, let alone hurt you. Please forgive me!"
The middle-aged man looked at his beloved daughter and then at Yang Dingtian.
"Alas..." The middle-aged man sighed, turned to Yang Dingtian and bowed to the end.
"I'm sorry, little brother. I, Ximen Wuya, am not strict in my discipline, and my heart is not hard enough. I can't bear to see my daughter's blood splattered on the spot, so I can't force my daughter to kneel down. I apologize to you here and ask you to forgive my daughter's fault!"
Ximen Yanyan was immediately stunned! Her father was the supreme master of the entire Yunxiao City. He was so noble and arrogant. But now he admitted his mistake because she bowed to this Maori savage.
Ximen Yanyan felt that her heart was about to burst. Her father was the person she admired and respected the most. Because of his own fault, his father suffered such humiliation.
"Dad, don't..." Ximen Yanyan stepped forward and knelt in front of his father, threw away the dagger in his hand, hugged his father's legs and cried loudly: "Dad, I was wrong! I shouldn't bully others, I shouldn't hurt his life, and I shouldn't hurt myself with a dagger and threaten you with my own life."
"Dad, actually I know everything. What should be done and what should not be done, but, but I really can't control my temper." Ximen Yanyan said while crying.
Ximen Wuya sighed softly, stretched out his hand to stroke his daughter's soft hair, and said, "Yanyan, how long has it been since you cried?"
Ximen Yanyan sobbed: "Since that incident when I was fifteen, I have never cried again."
This little princess from Yunxiao City was unruly and proud, stubborn and tough. She never bowed her head and never cried. Today, she cried loudly because her father bowed down. Although she knew it was because she made a mistake and she should not blame Yang Dingtian, she could not suppress her hatred for Yang Dingtian in her heart.
"Where are the things?" Ximen Wuya stretched out his hand and asked.
Ximen Yanyan took out the flame pendant from his arms, looked at it with both reluctance and hatred, and placed it meekly in his father's hand.
"Get up!" Ximen Wuya said: "Be brave and think twice before you act!"
"Yes! I understand." Ximen Yanyan lowered his head and said.
"Also, don't bear any grudge against this little brother." Ximen Wuya continued.
Ximen Yanyan gritted his teeth and said: "Dad, I can't help but hate him in my heart. But I will not retaliate against him in the future, I will not target him, let alone harm him. I will ignore him, not touch him, and I will not even look at him!"
Speaking of what happened later, Ximen Yanyan was already helpless.I couldn't suppress my resentment.
Ximen Wuya frowned, waved his hand and said half-heartedly: "You can go out..."
Ximen Yanyan glared coldly at Queen Yang Dingtian, turned around and walked out.
*******
"Little brother, your pendant." Ximen Wuya handed the flame pendant to Yang Dingtian.
Yang Dingtian took it and hung it around his neck again, saying: "Mr. Ximen is very sorry. If it were something else, I wouldn't mind giving it to Miss Ximen, but this flame pendant was given to me by my elder, and it is very important to me."
"I know, and even if it's not important, others can't take it by force." Ximen Wuya said.
"By the way, little brother, where are you going? If it's not the same as the direction I'm going, I can dial a speedboat to take you to where you want to go." Ximen Wuya said.
At this time, Yang Dingtian felt that the room was shaking slightly and asked, "Are we on the sea?"
